notes.title: Monday Madness Changelog (3/31/2025)
notes.content:
Welcome to this weeks Monday Madness changelog! 

Unfortunately due to several backend problems earlier in the week, this update is almost exclusively source code changes to improve performance and stability. However, these changes set up very nicely for some big additions that I hope to make soon!



[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed selecting cosmetic not working
[*]Fixed leaderboard API spam
[*]Fixed Item Shop not working
[*]Fixed bots using Disruptors not sending to other players
[*]Fixed XP slider bar starting full then going to actual value
[*]Fixed challenges not updating progress correctly
[*]Fixed some challenges incrementing multiple times per round
[*]Fixed leaderboards sending multiple times per event finish
[*]Fixed challenges not updating every challenge type correctly
[*]Fixed Soccer Master spamming ready to other players
[*]Fixed issue with selected skin resetting on launch 
[/list]


[h2]Performance Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved performance with Beanmoji achievement tracking
[*]Improved performance when getting Challenge Manager each event/match end
[*]Added better error checking and handling
[*]Made retrieving videos for skins faster
[/list]


[h2]Internal Source Code Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Refactored Drop Script
[*]Removed endStatTimer function
[*]Refactored statTimer to handle endStatTimer's old functions
[*]Set up statTimer to dynamically change transition types between match/event end
[*]Removed many IndexOf calls to increase performance
[*]Removed ability to hide scores on event/match end screens
[*]Changed skin from index system to naming system
[/list]


As always, thank you guys so much for reading! I know this update may seem small, but the changes on the inside set up for some of the biggest changes The Bean Trials has seen yet! I hope you guys are as excited as I am!

Have a great day/night!

TheRealGameDev

notes.title: The Bean Trials 1.02
notes.content:
It's finally here! After months of hard work, The Bean Trials is finally ready for release! There have been an absolute TON of new features so this list maybe be incomplete:

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new Minigame
[*]Added Decoration to the following: Number Memory, What's That Song, Track Race, Long Jump
[*]Added the ability for Bots to show up in games like Track Race
[*]Refined bot scores
[*]Fixed issue with skin showing up when tying for second place (FINALLY)
[*]Switched to relay's for p2p messaging to try and help with security
[*]Fixed a few softlocks
[*]Fixed a volume loading issue which silenced some sounds
[*]Made leaderboards update with Practice attempts
[/list]

[b]Cosmetic Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added over 40 new cosmetics
[*]Changed backend to make adding most cosmetics easier (beta testers might have issues converting)
[*]Added Color variants to some cosmetics
[*]Fixed menu song changing after opening a drop
[*]Added fade out to menu song when entering and exiting a drop open screen
[*]Fixed issue with Buy Coins text being behind shop after clicking on it then opening Shop again
[/list]

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added over 15 new Achievements
[*]Added little dropdown to show match search progress
[*]Bots now determine their scores before the minigame happens
[*]Added Beanpin difficulty to bot difficulty selection in Private Matches
[*]Fixed Join Code text not working correctly
[*]Fixed SSM in Private Matches
[*]Added fun transitions between Match Standings and Podium Screens
[*]Added 4 New Menu Songs
[/list]

I've really enjoyed working on this game and I'm so excited to continue to be able to! I hope you guys enjoy this update and stay excited while I work on even more!

Next update I plan on adding TEAM BASED minigames! I'm unsure about the timeline for it as they may be really hard to get working correctly but hopefully it won't be too much of a pain. Also be gracious with the bots being in minigames as the math is out of my understanding and may break randomly I'm not sure!

Okay with all of that said, enjoy the Trials and best of luck!

notes.title: Bean Trials v3.10 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the GameMaster had excessive booleans, leading to confusion in certain scenarios.
[*] Fixed the Achievement "!" incorrectly appearing or failing to appear when it should.
[*] Addressed a bug that sometimes prevented players from collecting achievements.
[*] Fixed an issue where extended win song variants prevented menu songs from playing until manually skipped.
[*] Removed Cookoff from the practice options to prevent a softlock when selected.
[/list]

[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduced Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond tiers for On The Line (currently marked as "coming soon").
[*] Implemented a new system to simplify the creation and addition of achievements.
[*] Added a spinning bean animation for loading screens.
[*] Introduced a pulsing note visual effect to match song volume levels.
[*] Added leaderboards for Canon Launch and Long Jump.
[/list]

[b]KNOWN BUGS:[/b]
[list]
[*] A bug that may cause the game to fail to sign in, resulting in a softlock on the initial loading screen. If you experience excessive loading times, please close and reopen the game as a temporary workaround.
[*] A bug allowing players to open a drop, enter a match, and receive no reward while losing the coins.
[*] A bug where a second-place tie for the third place podium skin fails to display correctly. (ongoing)
[/list]

[b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] MP Rewards: Adjusted to (20, 15, 12, 10, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0).
[*] XP Per Minigame Placement: Adjusted to (30, 20, 16, 14, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 3, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1).
[*] XP for Final Placement: Adjusted to (100, 80, 60, 50, 40, 30, 28, 26, 24, 22, 20, 18, 16, 14, 12, 10).
[/list]

This update is likely the last one before Christmas, unless a (Christmas) miracle ([i]see what I did there?[/i]) happens with On The Line's development timeline. As more visual elements are added, expect more (and potentially crazier) bugs—please report any you encounter! The On The Line bronze tier beta is expected to be released before 2025, and possibly even before Christmas if development goes smoother than anticipated. Enjoy the holidays, everyone!

notes.title: Bean Trials v3.03 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added [i]Limited Time[/i] shop.
[*]4 New Eyes.
[*]4 New Hats.

[/list]

[*] [b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed edge case where tied 1st place shows incorrect 2nd place podium for 3rd.
[*] Fixed decimal scores on whole number games and bots.
[*]Resolved Infinite Money Glitch (drops/refunds exploit).
[*] Fixed an achievement glitch where winning would not could as a top 3 placement
[*] Fixed a visual glitch that would show 'MP' instead of 'Coins' on final stats
[/list]
[*] [b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased certain achievement rewards.
[*] Increased coins earned per casual match.
[*] Buffed Hurdles bot scores.
[/list]
[*] [b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Settings panel now defaults to Audio Selection screen.
[*]Adjusted Long Jump for multiplayer.
[/list]
[*] [b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Optimized Customization rendering (~40fps → ~200fps, PC-dependent).
[/list]
[*] [b]Fun Facts of 2024[/b]
[list]
[*] The game's original name was B.O.O standing for 'Beautifully Organized Olympics'
[*] My brother came up with the idea for the game
[*] The first 2 minigames of the game were Dance Party and Canon Launch
[*] Gambling was creating by a coworker of mine
[*] Skins were not originally an idea for the game
[*] The original menu was based off of Rocket League's menu
[*] The current item shop is based of Rocket League's 
[*] The current menu layout is inspired by the Fall Guys menu
[*] Trials of War was supposed to be a FPS game based off a Roblox Game
[*] On The Line was a concept created by my friend (however it will never go live as I have other plans)
[*] My girlfriend designed and okayed 90% of the game's fonts, layouts, and colors (Thank you so much it looks way better with your help)
[*] All win songs used to be menu songs as well
[*] The idea of Glitched Items was made at 3am and the first Glitched Items were created at 3:30am
[*] Bots were originally only going to fill in to a even number of players
[*] Track Race was originally used flappy bird physics and a circular map
[*] Canon Launch's original name is 'Fartchery'
[*] Vault Crackers is the most hated Minigame
[*] Achievements were inspired by BTD6's achievements
[*] The 'Subnautica' glitch is a glitch where you could slow all timers in the game down with other apps
[list]
[*] This glitch was found using 'Subnautica' on my brothers laptop
[*] Sadly it only existed before the game's Steam debut
[/list]
[*] MP originally didn't have a true name, now it's Medal Points
[*] The placement colors are based off of Mario Party games
[*] Drops are based off of Rocket League drops
[*] The mountains in the back of the lobby use the Poop skin texture
[/list]

[/list]

I'm [b]incredibly[/b] proud of how far the game has come and am deeply grateful for the engagement and feedback I receive from our small but amazing community. I still remember when this game was just a black screen for a menu with 2 minigames and it wouldn't have got where it is today without you guys! This will be the final update of 2024, and big things are planned for 2025—and I can’t wait to share them with you. Thank you for being patient as this game has had it's ups and downs, and continuing to support this amazing journey! I hope to get a public release out to have many more people play Quarter 1 or 2 of 2025!

notes.title: Closed Beta 2.58 Changelog
notes.content:
A lot of things have changed in this new version including but not limited to: an entire menu redo, 2 new minigames (1 is practice only though), new challenge system, new loading system, new joining system, new music, millions of bug fixes, and new cosmetics!

A lot of work has gone into this update, however it is mostly visual. While visual updates are great for when people play, they tend to not attract people back like gameplay changes do. That's why 2.59 will be a revolutionary update!

2.59 will completely rework tons of minigames adding a whole new level of connectivity player to player.  Instead of feeling like a solo game, you'll be able to see how others are doing and play even more games! This update will rework a ton of multiplayer madness so be ready for a wait! This update will come in smaller chunks.

[b]2.59 Plan:[/b]
P-2.59-A will start the update sequence off by changing a singular minigame into the new version
P-2.59-B will refine that mode to fully receive feedback on the new minigame structure
P-2.59-C will start to change more minigames into this new mode
P-2.59-D will refine all minigames that have been improved, while maybe changing more
P-2.59-E will hopefully have everything smoothed out to play

**All of this is subject to change and deletion**
